Had a great afternoon in Hialeah for the launch of Latinos for Byron. Grateful for the warm welcome and honored to have the support of this incredible community.

Thank you, @mayorbryancalvo and Hialeah! 

I look forward to working together to Defend the Florida Dream for every family across our state.

Congratulations, Karoline and Nicholas, on the new addition to your family! Erika and I are overjoyed for you both as you welcome beautiful baby Viviana into the world.


Karoline Leavitt (@karolineleavitt)

On May 1st, Viviana aka “Vivi” joined our family, and our hearts instantly exploded with love. 💕 

She is perfect and healthy, and her big brother is joyfully adjusting to life with his new baby sister. We are enjoying every moment in our blissful newborn bubble.

Today, Justice Clarence Thomas officially became the second-longest-serving Associate Justice in history—a shining example of the American Dream.

We're talking about a man who overcame the weight of segregation to become one of the most consequential legal minds of our time.

In his 34+ years of service, he’s been a stalwart figure in the American judicial system, steadfast in his commitment to originalism and preserving the founding principles that built our Republic.

Great to be in the heart of Downtown Orlando to launch our plan to make Florida the Most Transparent Government in America by expanding DOGE audits, exposing wasteful spending, and giving taxpayers direct access to where every dollar goes.

 As Governor, I look forward to working every day to protect your tax dollars and bring full transparency to every level of government in our state. 🇺🇸

Spent the afternoon at @PortTampaBay seeing their operations firsthand.

This port is a critical piece in our state’s economy—supporting 192K jobs and supplying nearly half our fuel.

In Congress, I am committed to ensuring our maritime industry has the federal support it needs to keep our economy growing.

Thank you for having me, and I look forward to continuing our work together.

Had a great conversation this afternoon at The Getaway in St. Petersburg with Business Women for Byron. I loved hearing firsthand from the women who are powering our local economy and keeping Florida strong.

Looking forward to working with them to support small businesses across the state, and Defend the Florida Dream for every family.

Join us THIS FRIDAY, MAY 8 with Hialeah Mayor Bryan Calvo for the launch of Latinos for Byron.

Doors open at 12:30, we’ll see you there!

Photos from the 2-alarm fire at USF St. Petersburg.
